_about: Monochrome Cinema variant from Top-100 rank 70 (r22, snippco, Indonesian business doc, 16:9 source, 14 s; templated for vertical). The SERIF member of the family: most hero words are a soft glowing serif italic in white ('bisnis lo nggak grow', 'ROAS vs Volume'), small sans for connective lines, one line at a time near the centre of frame. Grade swings between desaturated near-B&W (seminar, office) and deep red-tinted shots (eye close-up, red studio). A struck-through word ('Achievement') for a dismissed idea. Measured: 59 picture changes/min (every ~2.4 s with zooms), caption every 0.89 s, captions 50% down, luma 80, sat 75, -12.2 LUFS, ~51 sound hits/min (busy whoosh/impact layer). Serif is a tall condensed italic with a soft glow; heroes build word by word into a multi-word serif line ('ROAS vs Volume'), mixed case.

director.style: Monochrome Cinema (serif doc): a near-B&W business documentary. The serif italic is the hero voice; one red-tinted shot per reel is the alarm.
director.captions: captions.heroes: one hero per phrase, and list EVERY hero in captions.serif too (serif-led). Keep case as spoken (acronyms, product names). Numbers stay ('ROAS 10x').
director.cutaways: 3-4 image scenes per 20 s, captions: true, 1.0-1.8 s: seminar rooms, screens with charts, an eye close-up. grayscale(1) contrast(1.2) brightness(0.86), and one in monochrome.redGrade. Use a strike beat when the speaker dismisses a word. Public domain / CC0 via stock_fetch.py.
director.rhythm: Picture change every ~2 s. Hard cuts, captions blur in.
